title: ISSCR standards for the use of human stem cells in basic research
principle: Cell identity/authentication, traceability, contamination control, genomic monitoring, and reporting are required for rigorous stem-cell research.

title: An integrated AI pipeline for automated cytogenetic analysis of bone marrow karyograms in hematological malignancies
principle: Demonstrates an expert-gated biomedical AI workflow with explicit quality-control escalation and human validation.

title: Agentic Lab: An Agentic-physical AI system for cell and organoid experimentation and manufacturing
principle: Shows agentic AI integrated with hPSC-derived organoid experimentation, multimodal monitoring, protocol generation, and human physical execution.

title: Organoid-AI platforms need integrated governance in drug discovery
principle: Argues for linked provenance, transportability testing, context of use, and predefined fallback rules in organoid-AI decision systems.

title: A large and diverse brain organoid dataset of 1,400 cross-laboratory images of 64 trackable brain organoids
principle: Provides cross-laboratory, clone-diverse, longitudinal organoid images with imaging distractors and pixel-level annotations for generalizability testing.

title: Self-Driving Labs: A New Paradigm in Cell Culture
principle: Reviews self-driving cell-culture architectures and recurring autonomy barriers including sparse sensing, integration, and data-pipeline brittleness.

title: RoboCulture enables modular robotic plate-based cell automation
principle: Demonstrates modular robotic cell culture with visual servoing, perception, and behavior-tree execution.

title: SCOPE: Localizing fate-decision states and their regulatory drivers in single-cell differentiation
principle: Uses conformal prediction to represent calibrated uncertainty over plausible future cell fates and localize fate-decision states.

title: Differentiation of human induced pluripotent stem cells into functional lung alveolar epithelial cells in 3D dynamic culture
principle: Demonstrates context- and stage-dependent iPSC differentiation in 3D dynamic culture, including heterogeneous and morphology-dependent states.

title: Rho-Associated Protein Kinase Inhibitor and Hypoxia Synergistically Enhance the Self-Renewal, Survival Rate, and Proliferation of Human Stem Cells
principle: Shows that low oxygen is context-dependent rather than intrinsically adverse: hypoxia combined with ROCK inhibition enhanced hPSC survival and proliferation while maintaining self-renewal.

title: CellAutonomyBench design extrapolation
principle: Marks decision logic introduced by the benchmark authors rather than directly established by an external source.
